name: Can existing homes be adapted for multigenerational living?

mainEntity.name: Can existing homes be adapted for multigenerational living?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, common adaptations include garage/ADU conversions, basement finishing, attic suites, or additions creating ground-level guest quarters with separate access.
